text: Handling deadlines well requires good time management and clear priorities. Start by making a realistic plan and deciding which tasks matter most, so you spend your energy where it counts. If a deadline looks impossible, manage the scope: agree with others on what is essential and what can wait. Communication is just as important. Tell your team or manager early if something is at risk, and ask for help when you need it. People respect honesty far more than a missed deadline with no warning. With good planning, sensible priorities, and open communication, you can meet deadlines with less stress and better results.
